title: Appointment Agreement Terms on Concurrent Appointment Series
content:
**Term.** A patient may hold at most 3 Appointment Series that are booked, active or paused at the same time, and never two such series of the same visit format funded by the same funding holding. A combined land and aquatic program funded by one plan of care is held as two series.

**What counts.** Only series in booked, active or paused status count toward the limit of 3 and toward the same-format test; a completed or cancelled series is not such a series. The funding holding is the one plan of care, Self-Pay Visit Package, Workers' Compensation Referral or Wellness Membership that pays for the series.

**How it is established.** The test is made on the system record before a new series is set up: the series already on file for the same patient, their visit formats, their funding holdings and their statuses. What the patient says about other series does not replace that record.

**Combinations (hypothetical holdings).**

| Series already held (booked, active or paused) | New series asked for | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by plan of care A | Aquatic Therapy Visit Series funded by plan of care A | May be held: a different format; together they are the two series of a combined land and aquatic program |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by plan of care A | Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by plan of care A | Not held: same format, same funding holding |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by plan of care A | Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package | May be held: same format but a different funding holding |
| Three series in booked, active or paused status | Any fourth series | Not held: the limit of 3 is reached |
| A completed Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by plan of care A | Standard 45-Minute Visit Series funded by plan of care A | May be held: the completed series is not counted |
